_note: Pod-local dimensions (D2, revision D2-R6 on params A1-R5, D-62 bay re-lay, D-64 pack, D-69 C3 fixes). Shared numbers (pod LE, L x W x H, base, board thickness, pack size, pack nominal centroid, pack aft travel, spar station, pitot tip) come from redesign/params/params.json; these are the pod-only ones. Read by subsystems/pod/fusion/pod.py, team/D2/pod_data.py and team/D2/pod_claims.py; read-only by F1 power.py, F3 avionics.py, F2 harness.py, C3, C5, A5. Metres unless stated.

nose_block_l_m.note: 1 mm thickened-epoxy (microballoon) bond line between the nose wall inside face and the fore face of the forward-stop T (XPS block A deleted at D-47; key name kept for C3, C5, F2, A5). x_fs = pod.x_le_m + board t + this + forward-stop t = -0.140 + 0.0048 + 0.001 + 0.003 = -0.1312 (D-62); nose skin to stop face 8.8 mm

fwd_stop_m.note: thickness x height above the tray top x width. R6 (D-69, CR-C3-15): a printed T, separate from the tray front piece: the upright runs from the flange under the floor, past the floor's front edge (the 3 x 54 mm floor slot), to 25 mm above the tray top; fore face on the 1 mm epoxy line to the nose wall, aft face carries the crush block

pack_aft_face_m.note: pack aft face: [0] CAD pack (F1 PWR-001) at the datum pod.pack_x_nominal_m -0.036 (16 mm stack, blue 8 + green 6 + white 2; D-77, was -0.032 / 12 mm); [1] the most aft face, no spacer, on the aft stop (centroid -0.020). Pack 0.135 long (D-64 Ovonic EC5). Read by F1 power.py, F2 harness.py and A5 cad_claims.py; pod.py checks item 0 against pod.pack_x_nominal_m

aft_stop_x_m.note: aft stop face = pod.pack_x_nominal_m + L_pack/2 + pod.pack_aft_travel_m = -0.036 + 0.0675 + 0.016 = 0.0475 (D-77: the datum moved 4 mm forward, the stop did not). CR-A1-62 and D-62 quote 0.050, which is the same sum with the retired 0.140 pack: with the 0.135 Ovonic pack a stop at 0.050 would put the no-spacer station at -0.0175 and the datum on a 14.5 mm stack, off the 2 mm grid (CR-D2-24 to A1). Back face 0.0505; C3's strut (strut_m) bears on it

aft_stop_m.note: thickness (C3: 3.0 mm, 2 mm root fillet) x top above the pack underside. Printed with the tray rear piece (POD-002). R6 (D-69, CR-C3-14): backed by the strut of POD-007 (3 ribs + pad over z 0.026-0.040), so the 1 mm tray root no longer carries the 1.4 N m moment; +x load: stop -> pad -> ribs -> foot bridge -> spar saddle + ties + wall brackets

gusset_m.note: two root ribs behind the aft stop at the bay edges (outside the strut pad, |y| 0.0245-0.0275), length aft x thickness; they are the C3 2 mm root fillet at the edges, not a load path (the strut is, D-69)

bay_min_m.note: inside L x W x H the pack bay must keep

tray_floor_t_m.note: PETG, 5 layers at 0.2 mm, epoxied full-area to the foam-board floor (CR-C3-01)

pad_t_m.note: closed-cell EVA pads with an anti-slip face; 2.5 mm keeps the 3.5 mm wire channel under the pack and the bay height

pad_len_m.note: one pad per strap station, centred on the strap slot

window_border_m.note: tray-floor lightening windows: border to ends and slots (x), to the guides (y); a window needs >= 6 mm clear length. R6 lever: y border 8 -> 6 mm

guide_h_m.note: bay side guides above the tray floor. R6 lever: 8 -> 6 mm (-1.3 g); they locate the pack in y, the straps hold it

slot_wall_m.note: foam left between the pod recess end and the spar-slot front face (recess unchanged from R2)

spacer_set_m.note: printed U-spacers behind the pack (POD-008): every 2 mm stack 0-20 mm. D-62: stations run from the no-spacer -0.020 to the crush-stack limit -0.0365 (C5 block 25.7 mm, 550 g class) / -0.0379 (A1's 24.3 mm): at most 16 mm of spacers; the second 8 mm spacer of D-47 is dropped. Colour by thickness: 2 white, 4 yellow, 6 green, 8 blue; each pack label carries its stack

spacer_flown_m.note: spacers in the CAD: the 550 g pack at the D-77 datum -0.036 with a 16 mm stack (blue 8 + green 6 + white 2); the rest live in the field kit. Was 12 mm (blue + yellow) at -0.032

spacer_bar_m.note: U-spacer leg width and bar (bar height 0.6 x this). R5a: 5 -> 4 mm (-0.4 g on the 12 mm CAD stack) to pay for the D-59 12 mm stack inside the 131 g allocation; bearing on the pack aft face 200 mm2 per 12 mm stack, 0.4 MPa at the 85 N crash load

spreader_t_m.note: printed PETG plate on the pack fore face, full block section

vent_m.note: ram-air inlet (nose wall, top centre) and equal exit (aft wall, top centre): width y x height z; air runs over the pack top

block_groove_m.note: vent groove in the top of the removable crush block and spreader: width x depth (7.8 % of the block section)

strap_w_m.note: hook-and-loop battery strap, rubber-backed, overlap >= 50 mm marked (CR-C3-01)

strap_x_m.note: strap slot centres. D-74 / D-77: the forward strap moves -0.062 -> -0.079 so its bay-side leg stays ahead of KO-PWR-BOARD / KO-PWR-SIDE (x >= -0.066): with the 26 mm slot the 20 mm strap spans at most -0.092 ... -0.066. Fore strap 16-25 mm behind the pack fore face for every D-77 station (-0.0365 ... -0.028); aft strap unchanged

strap_slot_m.note: x length (20 mm strap + 6 mm) x y width. D-74: 37 -> 26 mm so the forward strap cannot slide aft into KO-PWR-SIDE

plate_t_m.note: FC, avionics, PDB and JR plates (part of POD-002), 4 layers at 0.2 mm, epoxied full-area to the floor: no bending to carry (R3 1.5 -> 1.0 mm, R4 1.0 -> 0.8 mm, -1.3 g); the PDB bosses stand on the bonded plate

fc_board_m.note: CoreWing F405 Wing V2 top board alone: footprint x height on 4 gel cubes 5 mm; no screws, no inserts

fc_plate_len_m.note: board 52 mm + 2 x (2 mm clearance + 3 mm end stop)

fc_stop_m.note: end stops at both FC ends: thickness x height x width; 2 mm clear of the board so the gel pads isolate; the guide and side wall bound y

avn_plate_x_m.note: left channel: airspeed sensor (MS4525DO) between the tie posts on foam tape + 1 tie (CR-C6-07); RX crosswise behind it (x -0.0535 ... -0.0405) fully on the plate (R4: aft end -0.044 -> -0.040)

tie_post_m.note: two posts with a 3 x 1.5 mm tie slot each (x width, y depth, height): inner faces 21 mm apart (CR-F3-12 a), for the airspeed-sensor tie

pdb_plate_x_m.note: left channel: F1's bus board on foam tape between the boss rows and F1's power frame (PWR-006) on 4 nylon spacers over the 4 M3 x 5.7 heat-set inserts (E-PWR-03); R4: starts -0.038 (was -0.042) for the RX (CR-F3-12 b)

pdb_pattern_m.note: square M3 pattern placeholder until F1 names the PDB

boss_d_m.note: boss for an M3 x 5.7 brass heat-set insert (4.0 mm bore): R6 7.0 -> 7.2 mm, 1.6 mm wall (C6 boss-wall rule)

park_x_m.note: AS150U park zone in the left channel (mated pair 22 x 14 x 55 mm EST): F1's power-frame cradle (PWR-006, CR-F1-16) stands here, reachable through the hatch with the pack in; F2 asks it against the inboard guide (CR-F2-03 b)

ubec_zone_x_m.note: RETIRED by D-74 (UBEC PWR-005 and fuse PWR-007 deleted): the pod no longer builds the UBEC plate; the right-channel zone 0.044-0.074 now holds the right XT30U pair (xt30u_zone_m). Key kept only until F1 power.py / F2 harness.py stop reading it; then delete

hatch_aft_x_m.note: hatch opening ends here; fixed aft deck behind it. R6: every pack (aft face <= 0.0475), the aft stop (back face 0.0505) and the strut pad are inside the opening

lip_m.note: nose lip length x thickness; the hatch tongue slides under it

latch_tab_m.note: hook-and-loop latch tab, overlap on the aft deck x width

ant_tube_m.note: antenna A: printed tube through the hatch: OD, bore, top z (element starts here, >= 31 mm from the pack)

ant_tube_xy_m.note: above the receiver in the left channel

nose_ant_m.note: antenna B: printed tube out of the nose below the pitot boom: y, z, OD, bore; through the nose wall and the nose block

saddle_gap_m.source: collision/REPORT.md (2026-11-11); G3 practice (bond line, as station_collar.strip_slot_clear_m)
saddle_gap_m.note: handle saddle-tongue arc radius = spar radius + this gap (epoxy line). The arc was drawn on the spar surface and its chords cut 0.2 mm into the spar

foot_y_m.note: handle foot plate span each side

tongue_y_m.note: saddle tongue span each side (R3: narrowed to 14 mm round the tie at 0.036, -2 g)

foot_plate_t_m.note: foot plates and the stop bridge between them

tongue_cheek_frac.note: saddle cheeks stop 0.8 r above the spar axis

leg_m.note: square leg side, bore; R4: the RIGHT leg (FC side) carries the GPS cable (CR-F2-03 e), the left leg carries nothing

leg_y_m.note: R3: 0.034 -> 0.048 so the pack leads turn left behind the aft stop inboard of the leg

tie_y_m.note: R3: 0.048 -> 0.036 (clear of the moved legs); D1 lays the tie under the spar here (CR-D2-04)

grip_gap_m.note: finger room between the deck and the grip

socket_boss_m.note: mast socket on the grip: outer square, depth, bore square; 6.5 mm counterbore 4.5 deep on +y so the screw grip is 10.0 mm (C6 <= 11.0)

mast_m.note: square side, bore, height above the socket

gps_plate_m.note: GPS pad: square side, thickness, cheek thickness; pad tilted 45 deg toward the nose (normal (-x,+z)/sqrt2), arrow moulded on

socket_m.note: pitot socket: block square, bore (6 mm keyed boom, F3 accepted), length inside the nose wall, collar outside

flange_m.note: socket flange square (>= 30 mm) x thickness, bonded to the nose wall inside face

cable_exit_m.note: aft-wall exits each side: y from, y to, z from, z to (11 x 16 mm, outboard of the handle legs); R4: servo leads only (power and DShot use the side-wall exits, CR-F2-03)

fill.note: effective density fraction: plates <= 3 mm print solid; blocks 3 perimeters + 25 % infill

bought_g.source: EST (catalogue class values; weigh at build, T-D2-WEIGH)
bought_g.note: R4: mast_hw is now a PA66 M3x16 cheese-head screw + PA66 nut (CR-C6-18); fillet_corners = 6 mm microballoon fillets floor-to-side-wall +/-30 mm of each strap (CR-C6-17)

floor_channel_m.note: wire channel across the bay under the pack: centre x, width x, guide-notch height. R5: moved -0.0655 -> -0.0245 because the forward strap now sits over -0.0655; it now lands on the PDB plate (left) and the FC (right), 6 mm behind the forward strap-slot border, 17 mm ahead of the aft one. The tray splits here (10 mm gap down to the foam-board floor, 3.5 mm under the pack); both guides notched 3 mm at the base

side_exit_m.note: side-wall harness exits, both sides (power + DShot to the wing grooves): x from, x to, z from, z to (16 x 12 mm), edges taped

jr_bar_m.note: JR tie bar in the right channel: zone x from, x to; bar x width, height; tie slot width (y), height (z) at the bar foot, 3 slots; six JR in-line plugs tied across it

leg_window_m.note: GPS cable window on the outboard (+y) face of the right handle leg: z from, z to (bore opened to the face)

grip_bore_m.note: GPS cable bore along the grip (y) from the right leg to the mast socket; a 4 mm hole drilled down from the socket floor at y 0 joins it (BUILD step 2)

paper_shear_pa.note: C6 allowable for PETG epoxied to the foam-board paper face

fc_strap_slot_m.note: slot at the root of each FC end stop (y width x z height, 0.5 mm above the plate): a 10 mm hook-and-loop strap loops round the FC through both stops, 1-2 mm slack (secondary retention, 10 N)

tie_post_x_m.note: airspeed tie-post centres from avn_plate_x_m[0]: inner faces 21 mm apart (board 20 mm)

pitot_key_flat_m.note: socket bore key: flat on +z, 5.8 mm from the bore bottom (sleeve flat 5.6, OD 6.0 in the 6.2 bore): total/static cannot swap

pack_x_per_pack_m.note: A3's live stations after D-75...D-78 (2026-11-11): 546 g -0.036 (16 mm: blue + green + white), 550 g -0.034 (14 mm: blue + green), 590 g -0.030 (10 mm: blue + white); basic CG 48.8-49.2 mm, predicted 50.3-50.7 mm. Was -0.028 for 590 g (A1 D-62 estimate). H3 writes the flight card from A3's re-run on the balance-test day (CR-A3-27)

spacer_colour.note: PETG filament colour per spacer thickness (H3 writes the stack colours on each pack's flight-card label)

tray_front_solid_m.note: length of solid tray front piece behind the forward-stop T's fore face (no window). R6: the tray front piece starts at the stop's aft face (the T is its own body), so its solid zone is 30 mm

nose_ant_tube_in_m.note: antenna B tube length behind the nose wall inside face (block A that held it is gone): bonded in the 6.4 mm wall hole with an epoxy fillet; no load

bridge_x0_m.note: front of the handle foot bridge (the tie between the two feet over the slot fill, |y| < 0.029), 0.077 ... 0.0902. R6 (D-69): the strut ribs from the aft stop end on its front face, so it is again on the aft-stop load path (through the feet, the spar saddle and the wall brackets), not as a stop

fwd_stop_flange_m.note: R6 (D-69): flange of the forward-stop T under the foam-board floor: length aft from the stop fore face x thickness (width = fwd_stop_m[2], 54 mm). Bonded to the floor underside over 9 x 54 mm, so the -x root moment clamps the floor instead of peeling the tray. The pod nose overhangs the wing LE here (nothing below the floor); taped over with the shell

strut_m.note: aft-stop strut, printed with POD-007 (C3 CR-C3-14, D-69): a pad (pad = x thickness, y width; z = rib_z) epoxy-bedded on the aft stop's back face, and n_ribs PETG ribs rib_t (y) x rib_z (z 0.026-0.040, 14 mm) at y 0 and +/-rib_pitch_y from the pad to the foot-bridge front face (x 0.052 -> 0.077: 25 mm at D-62; C3 sized 14 mm at D-59; Euler scales by (14/25)^2 to about 2 700 N vs 85 N). Each rib ends in a heel (heel_t long) standing on the bridge top. The ribs stand 3.5 mm clear of the wing skin and 10 mm below the aft-stop top (0.0503) so the pack leads pass over them. R6 lever: pad 2 -> 1.5 mm (bearing 0.15 MPa)

bracket_m.note: handle-foot wall bracket, one per side, printed with POD-007: a web (web_t thick, on the wing-side face of the foot) from the foot plate's outboard edge (|y| 0.053) to a vertical flange (flange_t thick) on the side-wall inner face, epoxied to the wall over >= 1 000 mm2 per side (C3 CR-C3-16). The flange runs from flange_x0 (the hatch end, so it sits under the fixed deck) to the aft-wall inner face above the side harness exit (exit top + exit_clear_z) and down to the foot aft of the exit (x >= side_exit_m[1] + exit_clear_z), so the power / DShot leads keep their path. R6 levers: flange 1.5 -> 1.2 mm, web 3 -> 2 mm, flange from 0.058 to 0.066 (-2.7 g)

pdb_plate_x1_m.note: R6: aft end of the PDB plate. The plate keeps its boss pattern centre from pdb_plate_x_m (F1 reads that) but runs on aft under the frame and the cradle to 0.046 (D-74 follow-up: F1's cradle legs now stand on the floor right behind it, x 0.046-0.050, leg_setback_m 10 mm), 84 mm long, and is stiffened by two ribs (pdb_rib_m) along the boss rows: the AS150U unplug moment (1.94 N m) spreads over 84 x 36.7 mm of floor bond flat-wise (CALC-D2-PDB-PAD)

pdb_rib_m.note: PDB-plate ribs: width x height above the plate, one along each boss row (broken at the bosses), plate front to plate end, outboard / inboard of F1's bus board (>= 3.7 mm clear); below the boss tops so the nylon spacers sit on the bosses only

ant_b_tip_min_x_m.note: antenna B tube must not reach further forward than this (10 mm ahead of the pod nose, D7's nose pad gap)

floor_bevel_m.note: 45 deg bevel on the floor board's aft lower edge (x 0.065), bonded on the face of D1's recess-step fillet WNG-007; capped at the board thickness (4.8 mm), so the end face is one 45 deg slope and the floor end stays bonded across the step (C3)

ko_pwr_m.note: D-74 power-board keep-outs, x0 x1 y0 y1 z0 z1, left channel (board centreline y -0.04635 +/- 0.017). Pod bodies must stay out (CL-D2-KO-PWR-HITS), except: KO-PWR-PADS starts at the boss tops z 0.0266 because the PDB plate, its ribs and the four bosses under the deck window are F1's own frame mounts (E-PWR-03) and the bars sit on the plate; KO-PWR-SIDE-OUT (case U only) runs into the foam-board side wall (inner face -0.0652): the channel leaves 1.8 mm outboard of the board, not 6 (CL-D2-KO-PWR-SIDE-OUT, CR-D2-28 to F1). Replaces left_ch_clear_m (CR-F1-26)

xt30u_zone_m.note: D-74: room just inside each side exit for that side's two mated Amass XT30U (one per ESC, harness SPEC), x0 x1 y0 y1 z0 z1, level with the exit (z 0.027-0.039): right in the freed UBEC zone, left aft of the AS150U park (to 0.060), on the handle-foot plate (top z 0.0258) and inboard of the wall-bracket flange (|y| >= 0.064). Each mated pair ~32 x 10.2 x 5.2 mm (UNVERIFIED, measure) lies across the channel; two stacked = 10.4 mm of the 12 mm zone height. CL-D2-XT30U-HITS counts pod bodies in it (0)

xt30u_mated_m.source: Amass XT30U drawing (UNVERIFIED, measure at receipt)
xt30u_mated_m.note: mated male + female body length x width x height; the side exit (16 x 12 mm) passes one body (10.2 x 5.2) with the leads (CL-D2-XT30U-EXIT)
